purpose: Bounded prerequisite staging for the exact-head P1C01 Frodo/Gandalf skeletal candidate gate. This manifest contains only the four source packs authorized by P1C01HeroSkeletalCandidateWaveV1.
rules: Only the four P1C01 hero-candidate source packs are staged by this bounded prerequisite batch.
Only public downloads discovered from the official Quaternius pack pages are eligible; interactive/store-only routes remain unresolved.
Animated production-character candidates must reach the project as FBX; OBJ is not accepted as final animated-character evidence.
Production textures are PNG/TGA only; BMP is forbidden.
Staging does not promote any asset to READY_FOR_IMPORT, runtime integration, PIE, device, visual or performance acceptance.
evidence_boundary: Warehouse prerequisite only. Candidate ranking, import and runtime promotion remain separately gated.
